title: Internship - Research Analyst, Edureka
jobDescription:
Internship
- Research Analyst We are seeking to join our fun,fast growing team in Bangalore.You get a chance to work with ex-executives from companies based out of Silicon Valley, alumni from IIT, IIM, ISB, University of California, University of Chicago Duration, 6 months • 20,000 stipend per month Job Details • We are looking for a talented person with a combination of stellar design capabilities and strong technical skills to join the Content team. • The ideal candidate will be passionate about developing great tech marketing content based on raw inputs, have an eye for colours and typefaces, and pay keen attention to details. • We will provide you with a broad set of guidelines and you will then be empowered to bring your own creative vision to life and design presentations that create impact. • The ability to adhere to deadlines and produce quality output within agreed timelines is absolutely essential. • Understand the objectives, and target audience, and develop simple, easy-to-understand, user-friendly content while employing good search engine optimization (SEO) techniques. • Collaborate with SME/Technical experts and develop state of the art content, rewrite the existing content or edit and proofread content. • Research/analyze and solve complex problems in software technologies, frameworks, and platforms. • Create visual presentations that communicate complex concepts in a manner that appeals to a wide variety of audiences. Skills/Qualification • Fluent in English (written and verbal) communication, with an ability to express thoughts succinctly. • Excellent aptitude & logical reasoning skills. • Preferable knowledge on Linux & Cloud (AWS). • Preferable knowledge on any technology (Java / Java EE / Python / Scala / Hadoop). • Excellent programming skills. • Passion to learn & explore new and emerging technologies. Back to Job Listings SUBMIT APPLICATION

title: Associate Performance Marketing, Edureka
jobDescription:
Associate Performance Marketing We are seeking to join our fun,fast growing team in Bangalore.You get a chance to work with ex-executives from companies based out of Silicon Valley, alumni from IIT, IIM, ISB, University of California, University of Chicago

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Handle, review, and perform daily account responsibilities associated with Paid Marketing Platforms such as Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Linked In Ads etc. • Maintain and monitor keyword bids, account daily and monthly budget caps, impression share, quality score and other important account metrics. • Direct and handle new paid search campaigns, ad groups, and accounts and aid in the creation of paid search marketing initiatives. • Direct, handle, and be able to generate weekly and monthly reporting for all major metrics, goals tracking, revenue tracking, and other paid search initiatives. • Keep pace with search engines and PPC industry trends and developments. • Monitor and administer web analytics dashboards, reports and key reporting tools, and point out key areas of importance in accordance with business goals. Professional Competencies: • Preferred with a minimum of 6 months of experience in Digital Marketing. • Strong Analytical Ability. Passion for data crunching and analysis. • Attention to detail and the ability to effectively multi-task in a deadline-driven atmosphere. Back to Job Listings SUBMIT APPLICATION

title: Associate Research Analyst, Edureka
jobDescription:
Associate Research Analyst We are seeking to join our fun,fast growing team in Bangalore.You get a chance to work with ex-executives from companies based out of Silicon Valley, alumni from IIT, IIM, ISB, University of California, University of Chicago technical skills to join the Marketing/Content team, The potential candidate should be passionate about developing great tech marketing content based on raw inputs, have an eye for colors and typefaces, and pay keen attention to details. We will provide you with a broad set of guidelines, and you will then be empowered to bring your creative vision to life and design impactful presentations. The candidate should be able to drive You Tube channel growth and video marketing initiatives. The ideal candidate must have experience in understanding You Tube analytics and video production (storytelling, pre-production & post-production). The ability to adhere to deadlines and produce quality output within agreed timelines is essential.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Understand the objectives, and target audience, and develop simple, easy-to-understand, user-friendly content while employing good search engine optimization (SEO) techniques along with promoting the content on various channels and platforms • Create visual presentations and videos that communicate complex concepts in a manner that appeals to a wide variety of audiences • Collaborate with SME/Technical experts and develop state-of-the-art content, update the existing content or edit and proofread content • Identify the video topics that will bring a direct impact on the You Tube channel and revenue for the business • Drive and oversee a robust You Tube community calendar by supervising designers, collaborating with Research Analysts and being a judge of best practices in grammar, messaging, writing, and style • Measure and analyze the performance metrics and perform root-cause analysis for channel performance and leads • Be creative and keep innovating to drive fast-paced growth for content marketing channels Skills • Fluent in written and verbal English, with an ability to express thoughts succinctly • Excellent Aptitude & Reasoning Skills • Proven expertise as a content strategist with a solid foundation in content creation • Expertise in content marketing and driving marketing-funnel-focused communication and marketing efforts is a primary requirement • Good storytelling & presentation skills • Good understanding of You Tube analytics and growing it further to drive revenue. • Knowledge and working expertise in Content Management Systems and SEO tools preferred • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality, including proofreading, and maintaining design consistency • Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple projects and consistently meet deadlines and objectives • Preferable knowledge of Cloud, Dev Ops and Data Science and any technology (Java / Java EE / Python / Scala / Web Dev) • Passion to learn & explore new and emerging technologies Note • Work from the office • 5 days working. Back to Job Listings SUBMIT APPLICATION
